candidate_program.name: local_greedy_exchange
candidate_program.rationale: Estimates independently packable neighbor reward and scores a normalized exchange margin with a small crowding term. Reach is one hop; repeated greedy computations can be costly in dense neighborhoods.
candidate_program.rule: (weight - neighbor_greedy) / (1 + weight + neighbor_greedy) + 0.1 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
